description: List internal approval queue requests for this workspace (social drafts and blog articles; pending, approved, changes_requested or cancelled), newest first, with details, target mode, scheduled time and reviewer notes. Changes nothing.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

kind.description: Filter by content kind: all, draft (social posts) or article (blog articles). Defaults to all.

limit.description: Maximum approval requests to return (1 to 200). Defaults to 50.

status.description: Filter internal approval requests by status. Defaults to all.

name: approvals_list
title: List approval requests
